s0.title: Welcome to Nexus
s0.description: Nexus is a blockchain-verified ESG reporting platform. Collect data, calculate emissions, map to frameworks, approve through workflows, and publish assured reports — all from one place.

s1.title: Command Center
s1.description: The Dashboard gives you a bird's-eye view: module health, SBTi trajectory, and facility performance across all Demo Co operations.

s2.title: Data Collection → Calculator
s2.description: Start in Data Collection to submit entity and supplier data, then use the Calculator Engine to compute emissions using GHG Protocol methodology.

s3.title: Frameworks & Workflow
s3.description: Framework Questions assigns disclosure items to the right people. The Approval Queue ensures every data point is reviewed and blockchain-anchored before reporting.

s4.title: Analytics & Assurance
s4.description: The Analytics module flags anomalies against historical baselines. Assurance Review provides a third-party validation pipeline before publishing.

s5.title: Report Publishing
s5.description: Generate CDP, TCFD, GRI, and CSRD reports from a single verified dataset. Use AI Narrative for automated executive summaries.

s6.title: Every Number is Verifiable
s6.description: Look for the shield icon next to data points. Click it to see the full blockchain proof — who submitted, who approved, and the on-chain transaction hash.

mfa.title: Account security
mfa.intro: Add a second factor with a TOTP authenticator app (Google Authenticator, 1Password, Authy, Apple Passwords). After enabling, you'll be prompted for a 6-digit code at every sign-in.
mfa.recommended: Strongly recommended for accounts with publishing or admin permissions.
mfa.step1Body: Open your authenticator app and add a new account by scanning this code.
mfa.step2Body: Store these somewhere safe — each can be used once if you lose your device. They will NOT be shown again.
mfa.step3: Step 3 · Enter the 6-digit code from your app
mfa.promptEverySignIn: You will be prompted for your code at every sign-in.
mfa.confirmDisableBody: Once disabled, only your password will be required to sign in.

linked.title: Linked data
linked.appearsIn: This value appears in {{count}} frameworks. Approving here propagates to every linked disclosure automatically (skipping any that are locally overridden).

history.title: Historical reference
history.sources: Sources cited per year · confidence scored {{level}}

flags.yoyCritical: This is well above the 50% review threshold. Confirm this reflects a genuine change (restatement, boundary change, major project) or correct the data.
flags.yoyWarn: Above the 20% warn threshold — add a narrative justification in the comment field.
flags.zExtremeBody: Value sits {{z}} standard deviations from the 4-year mean. Extremely unlikely without a structural change.
flags.zWarnBody: Outside 2σ of the 4-year history — worth a sanity check.
flags.ratioBody: Often indicates a unit typo (tonnes vs kg, m³ vs litres). Double-check the unit and the scale.
flags.okBody: No statistical anomalies detected. Value tracks with 4-year history.

anomalyFeed.suppressTitle: Suppress — mark as acknowledged with reason
anomalyFeed.reasonTooShort: Explain in at least 10 characters — this is the audit trail.
anomalyFeed.suppressBody: Nothing is deleted — the anomaly stays on record and is visible via "show suppressed". Your reason is logged in the audit chain.
anomalyFeed.reasonPlaceholder: e.g. 'Boundary expanded in FY2026 to include Plant D, values not directly comparable'

blockchain.title: Blockchain Verification
blockchain.subtitle: Immutable audit proof
blockchain.verifiedBody: This data point has a complete chain of custody on-chain.
blockchain.explanation: This data point was submitted by a facility engineer, reviewed and approved by a data approver, then cryptographically anchored to the Polygon zkEVM blockchain. The Merkle root proves this data was included in a batch of verified sustainability records. The transaction hash can be independently verified on the public blockchain explorer. Once anchored, this record cannot be altered or deleted.
